data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure in order (Flights tab, origin and destination, dates, Done, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) and covers the one-way/multi-city variation, but it leaves out passengers and filters as explicit parameters and is a little vague on selecting the flight and choosing options, so it is mostly but not fully automatable.
